d:
Some animal encounters are so bizarre that even experienced rescuers can be caught off guard! Ernie Brown Jr. and Neal James face unpredictable wildlife situations that turn ordinary calls into extraordinary adventures. From unexpected discoveries to challenging captures, each animal rescue mission brings a fresh surprise and tests their ability to handle the wild.
As the duo tackles unusual wildlife rescue and wild animal capture cases, no two encounters unfold the same way. Which of these unbelievable moments will push Turtleman and Neal into their wildest situation yet?
